7. Finite coefficient output and immediate implementation sequence

The substantial integration work is now confined to (36).

Its polynomial set is

u,1−u,t,1−ut.

The only coupled singular corner is u=t=1. Set a=1−u, b=1−t:

1−ut=a+b−ab.

In the sector a=bx,

a+b−ab=b[1+x−bx],

and

1+x−bx=1+x(1−b)≥1

on the closed cube. The other sector is analogous. This supplies exactly the resolved-unit positivity certificate your code expects.
